title: Ask
lead: Six questions, in the order I ask them. Nothing is paid on this page: I read what you send and mail you the invoice.

fields.label: Who are you
fields.hint: Person or organisation, and an email address to answer to.

fields.label: Who decides, and who will use it
fields.hint: The one with the mandate is rarely the one who uses it.

fields.label: What are you about to build or decide
fields.hint: The solution as it stands now.

fields.label: What do you have
fields.hint: Paste the text. Links are not opened.

fields.label: What do you already assume
fields.hint: What is taken as true without being checked.

fields.label: The one question
fields.hint: What decision does this answer inform.

check_note: No model. The same rules the pre-scan test uses: three things must be present before a request is taken.

slots.who: who is asking and who decides
slots.task: what is being built or decided
slots.problem: what hurts now, or what is already assumed

routes.ask: Before it can be read, still missing:
routes.decline: Not a task I take: a question about the method, or no one behind it.

send_note: Opens your mail program with the request filled in. If it does not open, copy the request and paste it in a mail to
after: What happens then: I read it, mail the invoice from my own node, and the reply window of 7 days starts when the payment is seen.
contract_line: What a request and an answer look like: the task contract.
